capabilities.name: Extension Manifest and Package Contracts
capabilities.description: Define versioned extension manifests, package formats, metadata, compatibility rules, categories, migrations, and signatures.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Wave 1.17.1 Manifests package formats metadata and compatibility
capabilities.notes: Package categories include extensions, plugins, themes, templates, asset packs, workflow packs, and cloud-service modules.

capabilities.name: Local Extension Runtime
capabilities.description: Load, enable, disable, reload, update, rollback, and unload local extensions through controlled runtime boundaries.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Wave 1.17.2 Registry loader lifecycle updates compatibility and safe mode

capabilities.name: Installed Extension Registry
capabilities.description: Track installed versions, sources, paths, enabled state, ownership type, compatibility, installation dates, updates, and logs.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Wave 1.17.2 Registry loader lifecycle updates compatibility and safe mode

capabilities.name: Extension Safe Mode and Crash Recovery
capabilities.description: Detect extension crash loops, isolate recent extensions, recover startup, disable faulty products, and permit rollback or removal.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Wave 1.17.2 Registry loader lifecycle updates compatibility and safe mode
capabilities.notes: A faulty extension must not permanently prevent suite startup.

capabilities.name: Extension Permission and Trust Model
capabilities.description: Enforce declared project, file, network, cloud, AI, shell, Git, storage, slice, workflow, and device permissions with risk levels and revocation.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Wave 1.17.3 Permissions sandboxing signing trust and risk levels
capabilities.notes: Shell/system access is critical-risk and is never granted by default.

capabilities.name: Extension Signing and Verification
capabilities.description: Provide package signatures, publisher identity, verified status, tamper checks, sideload warnings, and trust metadata.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Wave 1.17.3 Permissions sandboxing signing trust and risk levels

capabilities.name: Extension Plugin and Workflow SDKs
capabilities.description: Provide stable SDKs, samples, test harnesses, packaging tools, development host, logs, permission simulation, and API documentation.

capabilities.name: Local Marketplace Interface
capabilities.description: Browse, filter, inspect, install, update, disable, remove, restore, and categorize local first-party marketplace products.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Marketplace UI and first-party catalog requirements
capabilities.notes: Listings distinguish free, owned, subscription, local-first, cloud-enhanced, and cloud-required products.

capabilities.name: Local Ownership and Pack Entitlements
capabilities.description: Represent free, buy-once owned, pack, and subscription products separately while preserving permanent offline use for owned local products.
capabilities.source: v1.17 — Marketplace ownership and entitlement requirements
capabilities.notes: Owned local extensions must not require continuous internet verification or an active subscription.

capabilities.name: First-Party Extension and Pack Catalog
capabilities.description: Provide free essentials, paid individual extensions, single-slice packs, multi-slice packs, themes, templates, plugins, assets, and workflow packs.
capabilities.notes: Initial owned-product pricing and pack structure follow the approved marketplace specification.
